This project adds the missing **notification layer** on top "},{"id":"p5s3","text":"of an agent's task lifecycle, so the moment an agent **completes**, **fails**, settles a **backgroun"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"d job**, or starts **waiting for a human** (approval / plan review / question), you get an in-page t"},{"id":"p5s5","text":"oast, an OS-level desktop notification, and an optional sound."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"> **Inspired by Codex's desktop-notification UX — not a Codex integration. Its lifecycle-detec"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"tion core is host-agnostic and is designed to grow into adapters for other coding agents."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Why this exists"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Long-running agent tasks invert the normal attention model: instead of watching a terminal, users su"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"bmit a task and switch away. UI-only status indicators (a spinner in a background tab) fail exactly "},{"id":"p8s3","text":"when they matter most — when the user is *not looking*. `dsh-task-notify` turns lifecycle transition"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"s into interruptible, OS-level signals, closing the feedback loop between an autonomous agent and a "},{"id":"p8s5","text":"ble, OS-level signals, closing the feedback loop between an autonomous agent and a distracted human."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Demo"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"> Recordings are not in the repository yet, so the table below lists the three clips by name instead"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" of embedding them. The capture plan (scenes, tooling, size budget) and the exact markup to restore "},{"id":"p10s3","text":"are in `docs/demo-guide.md`."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Turn completed | Review needed | Background job failed |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| `docs/demo-turn.gif` | `docs/demo-review.gif` | `docs/demo-failure.gif` |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- **Turn completion** — fires when an agent turn (thinking or tool use) finishes.
- **Background job"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"** — fires when a background command or subagent job settles (`completed`, `failed`, `killed`).
- **"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"Review needed** — fires when a running task waits for approval, plan review, or a question answer.
-"},{"id":"p14s4","text":" **Failure** — fires when an agent turn errors or a background job fails / is killed.
- **Three chan"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"nels** — OS-level browser notification, in-page toast, optional two-tone beep.
- **Per-event config*"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"* — every trigger and channel can be toggled independently.
- **Customizable** — title/body template"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"s, sound style and volume, toast corner and duration, quiet hours, per-session mute."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| Requirement | Notes |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| **DeepSeek Harness** | `0.2.0-rc.2` or newer `0.2.x` — the compatibility gate reads `peerDependenc"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"ies`, and every DSH peer is pinned to `^0.2.0-rc.2` |
| **Node.js** | `>=22.0.0` (CI runs Node 22 an"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"d 24; the shipped desktop runtime embeds Node 24) |
| **pnpm** | Needed only when installing through"},{"id":"p17s4","text":" the `dsh plugin` CLI. The desktop app installs with the pnpm it bundles |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"`<profile>` is the DSH profile to install into — `web` for a `dsh web` server, `desktop` for the des"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ktop app. Installing adds the package to the profile and registers its bundle patch, which inserts t"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"he single `task-notify` row that mounts both halves of the plugin."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"On the **desktop app**, install from the app's own **Settings → Plugins** surface. - Settings are stored locally in `lo"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"calStorage` only.
- The plugin **does not upload or exfiltrate conversation content**."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"The plugin runs with the permissions of your DSH process, like any other DSH plugin."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## Compatibility & Disposable Profile Verification"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"- **Node.js**: `>=22.0.0` (CI matrix: Node 22 and 24)
